fusions.name: Upward Hook
fusions.desc: A hooking upward stab that deals 14 damage, throws the target 3 tiles back and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skewering Charge
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away and gores it for 26 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Behind the Cape
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds, and increases your piercing damage by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Worth the Wait
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 35% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
